name: Advance Canonical URL
author: Usman Ali Qureshi

sections.description: Advanced Canonical URL is a powerful WordPress plugin designed to enhance your website’s SEO by preventing duplicate content issues. With its advanced settings, you can easily configure canonical URLs across your site, ensuring search engines prioritize the right pages for better rankings and improved visibility.
